 Ho Chi Minh City kicks off the year-end shopping season with hundreds of billions of dong in promotional packages.
 On the evening of November 11th, at Lam Son Park (Saigon Ward), the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade launched the "Vibrant HCMC - Shopping Season 2026" program, marking the beginning of a series of activities to stimulate shopping demand for the end of the year and the Lunar New Year 2027.
 Báo Sài Gòn Giải phóng • 11/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Delegates attending the event on the evening of November 11th. According to the plan, the program includes approximately 97 promotional activities with the participation of more than 100 brands, focusing on discounts, consumer incentives, and promoting multi-channel shopping. The peak period of activities runs until November 15th, while the entire program will be implemented until February 2027.
 This is one of the city's solutions to stimulate consumer demand, support businesses in expanding their markets, and accelerate the consumption of goods during the busiest shopping season of the year. 
 MM Mega Market supermarket chain participates in the year-end consumer stimulus program. Photo: HO GIANG Attending and speaking at the program, Vice Chairman of the Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee Truong Minh Huy Vu emphasized that connecting the city's stimulus activities with e-commerce platforms is expected to expand distribution channels, help businesses reach more customers, and facilitate shopping for residents and tourists. Through this, the program gradually connects the traditional retail system with digital consumption channels.
 The Vice Chairman of the Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee informed that in 2026, Ho Chi Minh City aims for double-digit economic growth, with services growing by 13.84%, requiring breakthrough solutions and the cooperation of businesses and citizens. The stimulus program will extend until the Lunar New Year of the Goat in 2027, offering discounts up to 100%, promoting competition through quality, reputation, and customer experience. The program will bring together approximately 66 shopping malls and 5,000 sales points, with total incentives exceeding 250 billion VND. The city aims for transactions exceeding 30,000 billion VND, stimulating demand by an additional 10,000-11,000 billion VND. 
 You may also like Consumers shop at Co.opmart Pro 230 Nguyen Trai Street (Cau Ong Lanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City). Photo: QUANG DINH
 Ms. Le Hong Thuy Tien, General Director of Inter Pacific Group (IPPG), said that with over 40 years in the retail industry, the group currently represents more than 138 international brands in Vietnam.
 During this period, approximately 500 stores ( fashion , cosmetics, luxury brands, restaurants, etc.) under IPPG will offer attractive prices to customers, bringing the Vibrant HCMC brand identity to each sales point. 
 Delegates attending the program on the evening of November 11. Photo: THU HUONG To ensure the program's sustainability, Ms. Le Hong Thuy Tien proposed building an annual shopping brand; perfecting the international shopping experience through tax refunds, cross-border payments, and multilingual information; connecting Ho Chi Minh City with ASEAN and Northeast Asian destinations; linking the shopping season with the night economy, international cultural, artistic, and sporting events; and establishing a public-private partnership mechanism to share media resources and data. 
 Tourists shopping at SASCO, Tan Son Nhat Airport. You may also like On the same day, the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade partnered with the Shopee livestream platform for the Mega Sale 11-11, taking place from November 11th to 13th, with a series of promotions. Specifically, buyers can use vouchers to get discounts of up to 350,000 VND for orders from 600,000 VND and above; Super Vouchers Xtra to get discounts of up to 720,000 VND for orders from 2 million VND and above; and a 700,000 VND discount at Shopee Mall for orders from 1 million VND and above.
 Residents can find information about promotions, shopping locations, and related activities on the two portals songdong.hochiminhcity.gov.vn and hello.hochiminhcity.gov.vn; information about Shopee promotions is updated on the platform's app and website.
